rules.name: combined-var-05-load-inputs
rules.sql: SELECT uuid, tenant_id, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp, business_unit, value_date, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, vol_id, p1_settleprice, invenio_product_code, future_expiry, option_expiry, future_continuation_series, option_continuation_series, derivative_type, strike, delta, gamma, vega, theta, delta1, gamma1, vega1 FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE business_unit IN ('CFS', 'USG') ORDER BY business_unit, uuid
SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, curr_mult, lot_mult, mult_factor FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE value_date IN (:vd1, :vd2) ORDER BY value_date, invenio_product_code

SELECT value_date, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, vol_id, p1_settleprice, invenio_product_code, future_expiry, option_expiry, future_continuation_series, option_continuation_series, derivative_type, strike, delta, gamma, vega, theta, delta1, gamma1, vega1 FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_accounting_report_rmc
